title: Implicit Bias in Intensive Care: Analysis and Assessment.
official: Implicit Bias in Intensive Care: Analysis and Assessment.
summary: This study uses clinical vignettes to explore how healthcare professionals make complex ethical decisions in intensive care settings. Participants evaluate several simulated scenarios, and their responses are analyzed to better understand decision making patterns.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Healthcare professionals working in intensive care units, including:

* physicians (residents, fellows, attendings),
* nurses,
* nurse assistants.

Exclusion Criteria:

* No criteria
